name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.NoiseHandle.additive_rectangle
title: Additive bit composition: path values satisfy the rectangle relation F(w) + F(w') = F(u) + F(u')
statement: Let F(w) = sum_i f_i(w_i) be a path value composed additively from per-bit pieces f_i(b) in an abelian group (secret parts, errors or gate values of per-bit-value encodings combined by addition). If, coordinatewise, the pair (u_i, u'_i) is (w_i, w'_i) or (w'_i, w_i), then F(w) + F(w') = F(u) + F(u'). So additive composition of witness-bit encodings gives exact +-1 relations among four paths (mix-and-match), for the secret part, the noise and any gate value alike.
